topics.name: VM Lifecycle Simulator
topics.concept: Virtual machines move through states, pending, running, stopping, stopped, terminated, with billing tied to each transition. The simulator models provisioning delays, start and stop latencies, and per-state costs across instance types. It teaches why stopping idle VMs saves real money.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates workload schedules with idle periods.

topics.name: Hypervisor CPU Scheduler
topics.concept: A hypervisor multiplexes physical CPUs across virtual machines, balancing fairness against latency for interactive guests. The simulator implements credit-based scheduling showing how weights and caps translate into actual CPU shares. It reveals the layer beneath every cloud instance.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates VM demand patterns with noisy neighbors.

topics.name: Container Runtime Simulator
topics.concept: Containers share the host kernel while namespaces and cgroups provide isolation and limits, which is why they start in milliseconds. The simulator models image layer mounting, namespace setup, and cgroup enforcement with startup timing. It demystifies the difference from VMs.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG synthesizes container specs with resource demands.

topics.name: Image Layer Analyzer
topics.concept: Container images stack read-only layers, and bloated layers slow every pull and deploy. The analyzer inspects simulated layer metadata, attributing size to layers and flagging duplicated files and cache-busting patterns. Slim images deploy faster and cheaper.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds Dockerfiles with layering anti-patterns.

topics.name: Object Storage Simulator
topics.concept: Object storage keeps blobs with metadata across erasure-coded or replicated backends, trading latency for eleven nines of durability. The simulator models PUT, GET, and multipart uploads with consistency and failure injection. It shows why S3 semantics differ from filesystems.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drives object operations with failure episodes.

topics.name: Block Storage Provisioner
topics.concept: Block volumes attach to instances with provisioned IOPS and throughput, and over-provisioning wastes money while under-provisioning throttles apps. The provisioner matches workload IO profiles to volume types, simulating latency under load. Right-sizing storage performance.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates database-like IO patterns.
topics.real_world_use: Used by DBAs sizing cloud volumes.

topics.name: CDN Cache Simulator
topics.concept: CDNs cache content at edge locations so users fetch from nearby, with hit ratios driven by popularity and TTLs. The simulator models edge PoPs, origin shielding, and purge propagation across a request stream. It quantifies the latency and cost wins of caching.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates content requests with viral spikes.
topics.real_world_use: Used by web teams planning CDN strategy.

topics.name: Load Balancer Algorithm Lab
topics.concept: Round robin, least connections, and IP hash distribute traffic with different fairness under uneven backends. The lab runs each algorithm against backends with varied speeds, measuring tail latency and utilization balance. Algorithm choice matters when backends differ.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drives requests to heterogeneous backends.

topics.name: Autoscaling Policy Tuner
topics.concept: Cloud autoscalers add capacity on metrics like CPU or queue length, but aggressive policies flap while timid ones miss spikes. The tuner simulates scaling actions against traffic traces with cooldowns and step adjustments. It finds the policy that tracks demand without oscillation.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates traffic with daily peaks and flash crowds.
topics.real_world_use: Used by SRE teams configuring auto scaling groups.

topics.name: Spot Price Forecaster
topics.concept: Spot instance prices fluctuate with spare capacity, and bidding strategy decides savings versus interruption risk. The forecaster models price history per instance type and zone, recommending bid levels and diversification. It turns spot markets into a planning input.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG synthesizes spot price series with spikes.
topics.real_world_use: Used by batch teams bidding on spare capacity.

topics.name: Reserved Instance Optimizer
topics.concept: Reserved instances trade commitment for discounts up to 70 percent, but only pay off above steady utilization. The optimizer analyzes usage history, recommends reservation quantities per shape, and computes break-even. Commitment becomes a math problem.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates instance usage with baseload and peaks.
topics.real_world_use: Used by FinOps teams buying reservations.

topics.name: Cost Allocation Tagger
topics.concept: Untagged resources make cloud bills unaccountable, so the tagger enforces tagging policy and attributes spend to teams. It scans the simulated inventory for missing or invalid tags and produces chargeback reports. Accountability drives efficiency.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds resource inventories with tag gaps.

topics.name: Billing Anomaly Detector
topics.concept: A compromised key or runaway job can multiply a cloud bill overnight, so anomaly detection watches daily spend. The detector learns per-service baselines and flags spikes with likely causes like new resource types. It pages before the invoice does.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG synthesizes daily spend with cost incidents.
topics.real_world_use: Used by FinOps catching billing surprises.

topics.name: Multi-Region Latency Router
topics.concept: Global users should hit the nearest healthy region, with failover when latency or errors rise. The router simulates latency-based routing with health checks across regions, measuring user experience under regional degradation. It designs for the region outage, not just the server one.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates user locations and regional health.

topics.name: Failover Orchestrator
topics.concept: Failover moves traffic and promotes standbys in a strict order: stop writes, sync data, promote, reroute, verify. The orchestrator executes the runbook against simulated regions with timing and rollback on failure. Practiced failover beats improvised failover.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates regional outages with partial failures.

topics.name: Region Capacity Planner
topics.concept: Each region has finite capacity and quotas, and big launches must fit. The planner forecasts demand per region against quotas and physical headroom, flagging constraints before launch day. It prevents the out-of-capacity error at scale.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates regional demand forecasts.
topics.real_world_use: Used by capacity teams planning launches.

topics.name: IAM Policy Simulator
topics.concept: Cloud IAM policies combine identity and resource rules where explicit denies win, and the effective permission is non-obvious. The simulator evaluates requests against policy sets showing which statement decided. It answers can this role do that definitively.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds policy sets with conflicting statements.
topics.real_world_use: Used by cloud security teams auditing permissions.

topics.name: Role Assumption Tracker
topics.concept: Temporary credentials from role assumption should be short-lived and scoped, but they sprawl. The tracker inventories assumed roles with duration, scope, and usage, flagging over-broad or stale assumptions. Least privilege for the temporary.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG synthesizes role assumption logs.

topics.name: Secrets Vault Simulator
topics.concept: Central secret vaults broker access with leases, rotation, and audit, instead of scattering credentials. The simulator models secret engines, dynamic credentials with TTLs, and revocation. It shows the operational pattern behind Vault-style systems.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drives secret reads and rotations.

topics.name: VPC Subnet Planner
topics.concept: IP address planning decides subnet sizes and AZ spread before anything launches, and mistakes are painful to fix. The planner allocates CIDR blocks across availability zones with room for growth, validating no overlaps. Address space is finite; plan it.
topics.data_idea: Subnet requirements derive from service plans.
topics.real_world_use: Used by network architects designing VPCs.

topics.name: Security Group Rule Analyzer
topics.concept: Security groups are stateful firewalls where rules accumulate into permissive mush. The analyzer audits rules for open-to-world ports, unused allows, and shadowed entries, scoring the attack surface. It keeps the front door narrow.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG fabricates security groups with drift.

topics.name: NAT Gateway Simulator
topics.concept: Private subnets reach the internet through NAT gateways that multiplex many private IPs onto few public ones with port limits. The simulator models connection tracking and port exhaustion under load. It explains the mysterious connection timeouts.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates outbound connection bursts.

topics.name: DNS Failover Simulator
topics.concept: DNS failover reroutes users by changing answers when health checks fail, but TTLs delay the switch. The simulator models health-check intervals, TTL propagation, and client caching during regional failure. It sets realistic RTO expectations.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates regional health with client caches.

topics.name: Service Discovery Registry
topics.concept: Microservices find each other through a registry with health-checked registrations, not hardcoded IPs. The registry handles register, deregister, and lookup with TTLs and health eviction. It is the phone book of dynamic infrastructure.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates instance churn and lookups.

topics.name: Serverless Function Simulator
topics.concept: Serverless functions bill per invocation with cold starts penalizing idle functions. The simulator models invocation patterns, concurrency limits, and cold-start latency against memory sizing. It reveals the true cost and latency profile.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates bursty invocation traffic.

topics.name: Cold Start Analyzer
topics.concept: Cold starts add hundreds of milliseconds when runtimes initialize, dominating latency for infrequent functions. The analyzer correlates invocation gaps with latency, quantifies cold-start impact, and evaluates provisioned concurrency. It separates code problems from platform ones.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG synthesizes invocations with idle gaps.

topics.name: Workflow Orchestrator
topics.concept: Multi-step cloud workflows need orchestration with retries, timeouts, and compensation on failure. The orchestrator executes DAGs of steps with state persistence and exactly-once-ish semantics. It models the engine behind step functions.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drives workflows with step failures.

topics.name: Batch Job Array Simulator
topics.concept: Array jobs run thousands of parameter variations, and schedulers must place them efficiently. The simulator models job arrays with dependencies across a cluster, measuring throughput and queue wait. HPC scheduling in miniature.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates job durations and dependencies.

topics.name: GPU Scheduler Simulator
topics.concept: GPUs are scarce and expensive, so schedulers must bin-pack jobs while respecting memory and topology. The simulator places GPU jobs with gang scheduling and preemption policies. It shows why GPU clusters need smarter scheduling.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates ML training job mixes.

topics.name: Data Lake Partition Planner
topics.concept: Partitioning by date or key prunes scans, but too-fine partitions create small-file hell. The planner evaluates partition schemes against query patterns, estimating scanned bytes and file counts. Layout is performance.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates query workloads over time ranges.
topics.real_world_use: Used by data engineers designing lakes.

topics.name: Lifecycle Policy Engine
topics.concept: Storage lifecycle policies move aging data to cheaper tiers and eventually delete it. The engine applies rules to object inventories, projecting cost savings and flagging premature transitions. Tiering automation with guardrails.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG ages object inventories.

topics.name: Cross Region Replication Monitor
topics.concept: Cross-region replication gives disaster recovery, but lag determines data loss on failover. The monitor tracks replication lag, backlog, and throughput per region pair, alerting before lag exceeds RPO. It watches the safety net.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG synthesizes replication metrics with lag spikes.

topics.name: Snapshot Scheduler
topics.concept: Snapshots protect against data loss, but uncoordinated snapshots bloat storage and miss consistency. The scheduler coordinates application-quiesced snapshots across volumes with retention chains. Recovery points stay meaningful.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG models change rates and snapshot chains.

topics.name: RTO RPO Calculator
topics.concept: Recovery objectives need numbers: how long can we be down, how much data can we lose. The calculator derives achievable RTO and RPO from backup frequency, replication lag, and restore speeds, then prices better objectives. It grounds DR discussions in math.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG varies backup and restore parameters.

topics.name: Compliance Drift Checker
topics.concept: Compliance frameworks demand configurations stay within policy, but reality drifts. The checker evaluates resources against CIS-style benchmarks, scoring compliance per control with remediation hints. Audit readiness becomes continuous.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG fabricates resource configs with violations.

topics.name: Tag Policy Enforcer
topics.concept: Tagging policies only work when enforced at creation time with clear remediation for violations. The enforcer validates tags on simulated provisioning, quarantines violators, and reports compliance by team. Policy as code for metadata.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates provisioning with tag quality variance.

topics.name: Quota Monitor
topics.concept: Service quotas cap usage per region, and hitting one mid-launch blocks scaling. The monitor tracks utilization against quotas with burn projections, requesting increases before the wall. Limits stop being surprises.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG grows usage toward quota ceilings.
topics.real_world_use: Used by platform teams preventing throttling.

topics.name: Event Source Mapper
topics.concept: Serverless event mappings connect queues and streams to functions with batching and filtering. The mapper simulates batch windows, filter patterns, and partial-failure handling. It tunes the plumbing between events and code.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG streams events with poison messages.

topics.name: State Machine Simulator
topics.concept: Workflow state machines branch, parallelize, and handle errors explicitly, and visualizing execution clarifies complex flows. The simulator runs state definitions with input passing and error catches. It debugs orchestration logic safely.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drives executions with failures.

topics.name: API Throttle Designer
topics.concept: API throttles protect backends with per-key quotas, but tiers and bursts need design. The designer models quota tiers, burst allowances, and overage handling against client demand. Monetization and protection in one policy.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates client demand across tiers.

topics.name: WAF Rule Tester
topics.concept: Web application firewall rules block attacks but also block customers when wrong. The tester fires attack payloads and legitimate traffic at rule sets measuring block and false-positive rates. Rules get tuned with evidence.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG mixes attacks with edge-case legitimate requests.
topics.real_world_use: Used by AppSec teams tuning WAFs.

topics.name: DDoS Mitigation Planner
topics.concept: DDoS response needs pre-planned playbooks: detection thresholds, scrubbing activation, and communication. The planner simulates attack volumes against mitigation capacity, sizing scrubbing and anycast. It prepares the worst day.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates attack ramps.

topics.name: Private Link Simulator
topics.concept: PrivateLink-style endpoints expose services without internet traversal, with DNS and policy controls. The simulator models endpoint provisioning, DNS resolution, and policy enforcement. It designs private connectivity correctly.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates connection setups.

topics.name: Transit Gateway Planner
topics.concept: Hub-and-spoke transit gateways replace VPC peering meshes, with route tables controlling the spokes. The planner designs attachments and route propagation for isolation needs. It tames multi-VPC complexity.
topics.data_idea: Network requirements derive from workload plans.

topics.name: Cloud Shell Session Recorder
topics.concept: Ephemeral cloud shells need session recording for audit, capturing commands without storing secrets. The recorder logs simulated shell sessions with redaction and playback. It balances admin convenience with accountability.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG fabricates admin shell sessions.

topics.name: Cost Anomaly Root Causer
topics.concept: Knowing spend spiked is half the battle; the root causer attributes it to specific resources and actions. It diffs resource inventories across the spike window ranking likely culprits. Investigation time collapses.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG injects cost incidents into spend data.

topics.name: Savings Plan Analyzer
topics.concept: Savings plans discount compute in exchange for hourly commitments, with utilization deciding the payoff. The analyzer models commitment levels against usage variability. It optimizes the commitment portfolio.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates compute usage with variability.
topics.real_world_use: Used by FinOps buying savings plans.

topics.name: Graviton Migration Estimator
topics.concept: ARM-based instances promise better price-performance, but migration needs measurement. The estimator models workload portability, benchmarks simulated performance, and projects savings. It de-risks architecture transitions.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG profiles workload characteristics.

topics.name: Multi Account Strategy Planner
topics.concept: Multiple accounts isolate blast radius and simplify billing, but need organization design. The planner models OU structures, SCP guardrails, and cross-account roles. It designs the account foundation.
topics.data_idea: Account needs derive from team structures.

topics.name: Service Control Policy Tester
topics.concept: SCPs set permission guardrails across accounts, where denies override everything. The tester evaluates actions against SCP hierarchies showing effective permissions. It previews guardrail impact safely.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds SCP sets with conflicts.

topics.name: CloudTrail Log Analyzer
topics.concept: CloudTrail records every API call, the ultimate audit source and a haystack for incident response. The analyzer parses call logs, flags anomalous actions like privilege escalations, and builds timelines. It turns API exhaust into evidence.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG synthesizes API calls with attacker activity.

topics.name: Config Rule Evaluator
topics.concept: Config rules continuously audit resource compliance, like requiring encryption or tags. The evaluator runs rules against inventory snapshots with pass, fail, and not-applicable outcomes. It automates the compliance checklist.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG fabricates inventories with drift.

topics.name: Backup Vault Planner
topics.concept: Backup vaults with immutability protect against ransomware encrypting the backups too. The planner designs vault policies with lock periods and cross-account copies. It makes backups the last line that holds.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG models backup chains under attack.

topics.name: Edge Function Router
topics.concept: Edge functions run logic at CDN PoPs for personalization and auth at the edge. The router simulates request handling with regional logic and origin fallback. It pushes compute to the user.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG routes requests with edge logic.

topics.name: Origin Shield Designer
topics.concept: Origin shields add a mid-tier cache layer so origins face one region instead of every edge. The designer models shield placement against origin load and cache efficiency. It protects origins from thundering herds.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates cache misses needing origin fetch.

topics.name: Cloud Cost Dashboard
topics.concept: Cost dashboards translate raw billing into team-accountable views with trends and forecasts. The generator builds dashboards from cost and usage records with anomaly highlights. Visibility precedes optimization.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG synthesizes billing records.

topics.name: Instance Rightsizer
topics.concept: Cloud instances are routinely oversized, and rightsizing recommendations need utilization evidence. The analyzer computes CPU and memory percentiles per instance recommending smaller shapes with headroom. It finds the waste hiding in averages.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates instance utilization.

topics.name: Container Cost Allocator
topics.concept: Kubernetes costs need attribution to namespaces and teams despite shared nodes. The allocator splits node costs by request, usage, and idle overhead with showback reports. Shared infrastructure gets fair bills.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG synthesizes cluster utilization.

topics.name: FinOps Alert Engine
topics.concept: Budget alerts should fire before overspend, with context about what is driving it. The engine watches forecasted spend against budgets with severity tiers. It makes budgets self-enforcing.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drives spend toward budget breaches.

topics.name: Green Computing Scheduler
topics.concept: Carbon-aware scheduling shifts flexible workloads to times and regions with cleaner energy. The scheduler models carbon intensity forecasts placing batch jobs accordingly. It trades a little latency for a lot less CO2.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG synthesizes carbon intensity curves.

topics.name: Disaster Recovery Tester
topics.concept: DR tests prove recovery works, measuring actual RTO against targets with game-day scenarios. The tester orchestrates simulated failovers scoring each phase. Confidence comes from practice.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG runs failover drills with timing.
